system.monsterType: Monster (Common).,A stirge is a birdlike creature with a long nose.
system.description: It attacks by thrusting its beak into the victim's body, and feeds on blood. A successful hit (for 1d3 points of damage) means that it has at- tached itself to the victim, sucking for 1d3 points of damage per round until the victim is dead. A flying stirge gains a bonus of + 2 on its first attack roll against any one opponent due to its speedy diving attack. ---
